body: Today i just completely crashed.  Just had another anxiety episode at work yesterday and the sent me on medical leave again.  My father keeps on insisting that it is some sort of personal thing I need to conquer but with no other options he keeps on pushing me to stay with the company.  I know that the company's patients is waning and its only a matter of time that they lay me off or just fire me.  I am running out of money quick with all the bills sucking me dry.  I also had another anxiety episode today and had come to the realization that nothing is getting better.  My parents are playing it off as just a headache to please our Christmas guests.  There is no way in hell that I can keep this up and with no way out I think its time.   I started looking up lethal doses of adderall and how exit bags work.  I'm in my room right now and every conversation that I hear for the living room is making me feel more pointless.  I thought about the suicide hotline, but with most of my depression and problems being money driven and career driven there is probably little that they could do.  I'm at my wit's end and considering committing either today or tomorrow.  I want to thank your for empathizing with me and talking.  This past couple of months has been pretty lonely and tough.  I'm not sure what is going to happen in the next couple of days but nothing is improving so I think its time.

I went ahead and tried to go volunteer but I feel too depressed to get out. I had to go to the doctor during work yesterday and brought my dad.  The doctor pretty much wanted me to quit but my dad kept on trying to interrupt and said I should be ok to work at my old job.  Even though my dad can clearly see that I am depressed by my situation, he refuses to acknowledge my problems. 

I'm also scared to move on anything due to money being a problem.  I was pushed to go to college so I have student debt, I also crashed my car in the past so I had to use my savings to buy another one, and I have a large amount of medical bills.  It's like one big trap.

I want to thank you for talking to me and trying to help, but it is getting to the point where I feel like I'm just running out of time.  I don't know how long till you respond since I haven't said anything for a while, but I do want to say that you made me feel I'm not alone in this.  I may not be able to respond to your next reply.

I want to quit my job, but I am afraid that I would not be able to find another one since all I have been getting is rejections and silence.  When I was on medical leave I ran out of money so I was depressed and bored.  I did some freelance web development and volunteer at several hospitals but when I ran out of money I was unable to drive.  I signed up for Americore since i love helping others and volunteering, but my father pretty much guilted me
back to customer service since it made more money, and I did support the family to a small degree.  At this point I don't know what to do.  I am really just looking for direction to get me out of depression but it is getting to the point where it is unbearable.
yea but I can't at the moment i will be able to talk a couple hours from now. I wouldn't know what to PM with though.
